subject.title: [Feature]: Semantic Message Aggregation: merge rapid-fire short messages and split multi-topic long messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic semantic ingress aggregation contract beyond fixed debounce, and if so should it include adaptive timing, long-message topic splitting, or only explicit bundle metadata first?
rationale: The remaining request adds public config/API surface and changes how inbound fragments become model-visible session turns, so automation cannot safely choose defaults, transcript shape, semantic splitting policy, or overlap with existing adaptive and continuation-marker trackers.

options.title: Design Narrow Generic Ingress Contract
options.body: Add one opt-in cross-channel ingress contract for bundle metadata and approved timing behavior first, then evaluate semantic topic splitting as a separate follow-up.

options.title: Keep Fixed Debounce Only
options.body: Document messages.inbound debounce and queue collect as the supported core behavior, then close semantic/adaptive expansion as not planned.

options.title: Move Semantics Behind Plugin/API Seam
options.body: Defer semantic splitting until a typed plugin or channel ingress hook can implement it without growing global message config directly.

recommendation.title: Design Narrow Generic Ingress Contract
recommendation.body: Add one opt-in cross-channel ingress contract for bundle metadata and approved timing behavior first, then evaluate semantic topic splitting as a separate follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across shared inbound debounce policy, original debounce merge review, and product-review context for this cluster.
